lines.text: Hoshea son of Elah became king of Israel and reigned in Samaria nine years, doing evil but not like earlier kings.
Hoshea sent envoys to King So of Egypt and stopped paying tribute, so the king of Assyria imprisoned him.
After besieging Samaria for seven years, the king of Assyria captured it and settled the Israelites in Halah, Gozan, and the cities of the Medes.
The Israelites abandoned all the LORD's commandments, made two cast idols of calves and an Asherah pole, and served Baal.
The LORD removed Israel from His presence, leaving only the tribe of Ephraim, and Jeroboam son of Nebat led Israel away from Him.
